comment: Inference rules for the symbolic track. A literal is predicate(ENTITY); a leading '-' means negation. Rules fire forward from extracted claims until nothing new is derived. Contradiction = a derived literal whose negation is an axiom from creed.json.

rules.why: A creature has a beginning and is not true God.
A Son adopted in time is not begotten of the Father before all ages.
Only human means not true God.
A lesser or secondary god is not of one substance with the Father.
A merely apparent humanity cannot truly suffer and die.
Without a human mind or soul he is not fully human.
One who never existed was not incarnate or crucified.
An impersonal force is not the Lord, worshipped with the Father and the Son.
A created power is not worshipped and glorified with the Father and the Son.
Modes or masks of one person are not distinct.
Three gods or many gods is not one God.
If a lesser or evil being made the world, the one God is not Maker of all things visible.
If he did not die, he did not rise from the dead.
If someone else was crucified in his place, he was not crucified.
